PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "I1":    (8e-6, 4e-6, 12e-6),
    "Isf":   (7e-6, 4e-6, 10e-6),
    "Rf":    (450e3, 380e3, 650e3),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidsf":(15.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "Lsf":   (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ipb = 1.5e-6
    gmid_b, Lb, gmid_p = 12.0, 1.0, 10.0
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15

    # --- input CS NMOS: gate = drain (DC via Rf) ---
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], p["I1"], vds=0.5)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], p["I1"], vds=m1.vgs)
    vx = m1.vgs

    # --- PMOS source follower (bulk = own source), out of loop ---
    msf = lut.size("p", p["gmidsf"], p["Lsf"], p["Isf"], vds=1.3)
    msf = lut.size("p", p["gmidsf"], p["Lsf"], p["Isf"], vds=vx + msf.vgs)
    vout = vx + msf.vgs

    # --- bias: ibias NMOS diode -> NMOS mirror -> PMOS diode -> PMOS sources ---
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mp0 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ipb, vds=0.9)
    mp0 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ipb, vds=mp0.vgs)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Ipb, vds=vdd - mp0.vgs)
    ml = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], p["I1"], vds=vdd - vx)           # CS load
    ms = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], p["Isf"], vds=max(vdd - vout, 0.2))  # SF source

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp0)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("ML", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", ml)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "x", p["Rf"])
    n.dev("MSF", "vss", "x", "vout", "vout", msf)
    n.dev("MS", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", ms)

    # --- small-signal prediction ---
    gm1 = m1.gm; gX = m1.gds + ml.gds
    Cf = m1.cgd
    Cin = cpd + (m1.cgg - m1.cgd)
    gsf_tot = msf.gm + msf.gds + ms.gds
    Gsf = msf.gm / gsf_tot
    CX = max(m1.cdd - m1.cgd, 0.0) + ml.cdd + msf.cgd + (1 - Gsf) * max(msf.cgg - msf.cgd, 0.0)
    Co = cl + ms.cdd
    Rf = p["Rf"]

    f = np.logspace(3, 10, 3000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    det = (s * Cin + Yf) * (gX + s * CX + Yf) + Yf * (gm1 - Yf)
    X = -(gm1 - Yf) / det
    Z = np.abs(X * Gsf / (1 + s * Co / gsf_tot))
    z0 = Z[0]
    below = np.where(Z < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3 = float(f[below[0]]) if len(below) else 1e10

    # noise at 1 MHz
    gam = 0.8
    en2 = 4 * kT * gam / gm1 * (1 + ml.gm / gm1)
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * ((1 / Rf) ** 2 + (w * (Cin + Cf)) ** 2)

    power = vdd * (iref + Ipb + p["I1"] + p["Isf"])
    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": 20 * math.log10(z0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
        "A0": gm1 / gX, "CX_fF": CX * 1e15, "Gsf": Gsf,
    }
